blurb: Hideaway Marina is located on the James River Arm of Table Rock Lake in Galena, Missouri. They offer boat rentals including ski boats, fishing boats, pontoon boats, paddleboards, tubes, and skis. The marina also provides covered slips, a ship store with food, fuel, tackle, and bait, and a pizza restaurant on site.
